1SA.13.1.comparison_source: USFM omits editorial brackets from forty
1SA.13.1.evidence: Original printed 1901 edition PDF page 313 uses square brackets around the conjectural age; the marginal note explains the number is missing in the Hebrew text.

1SA.14.49.evidence: The printing of 1 Samuel 14:49 on original PDF page 316 has Malchi- at the end of a line and shua on the next line, which alone could be a line-break hyphen; original 1 Samuel 31:2 (PDF page 337) prints Malchi-shua within a single line, establishing the intended hyphenation.
